reviews.text: Do not trust these guys.  Dishonest, unreliable, incompetent.  They charged me over $1000 to try to find a problem in my plumbing system, left after theee hours and said they would come back the next day.  Now it's been 2 weeks and they do not answer the phone or return my messages.  Stay away.

I can't even give them one star. The worst company and the worst service I've ever encountered on the Island of Montreal.

They came in one day, poorly equipped, and couldn't even provide me with a complete report about the French drain camera test. Furthermore, they're asking for money for work they didn't do. They also drained my hot water to thaw their pipes. This is a company that doesn't deserve to have their RBQ and CMMTQ licenses. They don't even know how to treat their customers properly.
P.S. I'm forced to give one star to post this, but I don't recommend them and they don't deserve that star.

Very bad experience... Horrible...... They came to do a drain inspection on a very rainy day, I paid $1500 (Excavation + camera + report), so far so good... Afterwards I called several times to try to get my report, they told me "you will receive the report this week", then "we don't have your email address" (I gave it 3 times), and then they told me that because of the water they were unable to inspect, that they will come back to pass the camera but that they will not charge me... Then the end: they ask me almost $700 for this second visit...???? They want me to believe that after more than 10 years of practice they did not know that the rain would prevent them from inspecting properly....? What a lack of professionalism, not to mention that he hung up on me when I expressed my dissatisfaction... I am currently in the process of filing a complaint with the CMMTQ and probably soon with the RBQ to denounce this type of practice... I encourage people who are victims of this type of problem to do the same thing, perhaps this will prevent others from suffering such a level of professional and relational incompetence.... And above all, don't hesitate to post your opinions on Google to help others in choosing their contractor...

If it were possible, I would give him a 0. Unpleasant, unprofessional, he didn't show up to do the work he agreed to do after we had completed all the permit procedures. He doesn't care about his customers at all. Run away!
